rules.documentTitle: How to play Rikiki? – rules | Rikiki Counter
rules.tagline: The goal: guess exactly how many tricks you'll take in the round!

steps.title: The cards
steps.text: Each round deals a different number of cards. The count goes down from the max to 1, then back up to the max — and the game ends.

steps.title: The trump
steps.text: Every round has a trump suit (sometimes there's no trump at all). Trump beats every other suit.

steps.title: Guessing
steps.text: Everyone guesses how many tricks they'll win that round. Guesses are only revealed once EVERYONE has locked theirs in.

steps.title: Who leads?
steps.text: A different player leads the first trick each round (in turn order). After that, whoever won the previous trick leads the next one.

steps.title: Playing cards
steps.text: You must follow the suit that was led. If you don't have that suit, you can play anything — trump or another suit. You're not required to win the trick.

steps.title: Who wins the trick?
steps.text: The highest card. Trump beats every other suit; if no trump was played, the highest card of the led suit wins. You're not required to overtrump.

steps.title: Scoring
steps.text: You enter how many tricks each player won, and the app automatically tracks the score round by round.

rules.scoringHitText: +10 points, plus +2 points for every trick you won.
rules.scoringMissText: −4 points for every trick of difference (guess ↔ actual).
